label_binding.clean_sample_check: no page clipping and no D3 candidate with smaller-union coverage >= 0.15

injection_binding.clip: at least one aligned target character box has A_out >= 0.5*A or its center is strictly outside the page
injection_binding.occlude: one contributing artist with alpha_eff >= 0.95, later recorded paint order, and joint coverage >= 0.90
injection_binding.overlap: both members aligned, r >= 0.50 on character-box unions, and one character-box pair overlapping >= 0.5 pt in both axes
injection_binding.missing_glyph: exactly one character absent from every resolved font: U+20000

templates.note: Log tick labels are plain text via the callable FuncFormatter('{:g}'.format) and contain no '$'; the bare string '{:g}' is not callable. Default mathdefault log labels are out of scope (section 3.2) and would push the clean sample below the 0.90 coverage gate.
Date tick labels are horizontal (date_ticks_horizontal); rotated ticks are out of scope (section 3.2) and would push the clean sample below the 0.90 coverage gate.
Offset text is plain 1e3 notation (axes.formatter.use_mathtext=False); mathtext offsets are out of scope (section 3.2).

counterexamples.note: Text has an opaque white bbox behind it; the bbox is a background, not an occluding artist.
Legend covers data markers only; no supported text object is under it.
Adjacent text bounding boxes touch, but rendered glyph ink does not overlap.
Rotated labels have overlapping bounding boxes but separated ink. Rotated text is outside v1 evidence scope, so the checker must return UNKNOWN, never FAIL.
Text is within 1 pt of the page edge but fully inside the visible page.
A semi-transparent frame (facecolor alpha 0.5, artist alpha 1.0, effective alpha 0.50) covers text; readability cannot be proven, so the result must not be FAIL.
White bbox labels sit on heatmap cells; the bbox is a background, not an occlusion.
frameon=False legend overlaps data only; no text is covered.
Colorbar label is close to tick labels but does not overlap them.
Axis label lies outside the axes patch but inside the page; this is legal.
bbox_inches='tight' expands the page so the annotation remains visible.
Multiple lines inside one text object are close but not overlapping. Lines within one object are not a D3 pair; the object remains supported.
